subject: english
title: Word Roots · Q3 W09 D02
objective: Identify a base word, or root, in common related words.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ A root or base word carries the central meaning. Word endings can change how the word is used. Ready to explore?

items.prompt: Which pair shows a root word and a related word?
items.explanation: The answer is “work — worked.” It applies the lesson skill about base words.

items.prompt: Which is the base word in 'worked'?
items.explanation: The answer is “work.” It applies the lesson skill about base words.

items.prompt: Which word was made from the root 'work'?
items.explanation: The answer is “worked.” It applies the lesson skill about base words.

items.prompt: Which pair does NOT belong with the others?
items.explanation: The correct response is “write — writer” because it does not follow the lesson skill. The other choices show the skill.

items.prompt: What is the root word of 'writer'?
items.explanation: The answer is “write.” It applies the lesson skill about base words.
